text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute suffers an injury during
training, so
I rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Owww...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I still had more in me, but I
guess not.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, bother. A mistake like that just
shows how
inexperienced I am... That
said, I do still have
energy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. I believe exercise is an
important
part of recovery. What do you
say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd say that. I could feel it in
my bones.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But I suppose you're right. We can't let
this injury
get any worse than it already
is.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right. I suppose I'll have to take it easy
for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't exactly seem satisfied, but
Wonder
Acute accepts my decision.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying. If this injury
gets any
worse, it's curtains for me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Oof.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even just walking hurts... I think we
should
probably call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll count today as another example that
rushing
only makes things worse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute puts a positive spin on it,
but it's
clear from the slump in her
shoulders how
disappointed she is.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to go all out, but it
still feels
good being out here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I knew light training would be just the
ticket to
pep me up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Wonder Acute patiently
performs a
training regimen, keeping her
limits in mind.
